result: Both review findings fixed; focused checks green; ready for independent re-review.

fixes.major: Shared offline helper defaults an unset/empty BRAIN_SHADOW_ROOT to private temporary state; watcher TEST_ENV is explicit and both child containment paths propagate the default into minimal environments while respecting explicit overrides.
fixes.minor: Identity-desk recipients use the canonical directory carrying the .identity-root file; a Git checkout is not required. Unavailable or unmarked targets remain unknown. Documentation updated.

regressionEvidence: Fresh/inherited helper defaults and explicit root overrides exercised in subprocesses, with inherited and minimal synchronous/asynchronous child environments.
Selected pre-existing watcher and promotion fixtures plus the real desk request helper actually append shadow entries under temporary state while the fixture HOME default state root stays absent.
Request fixture teardown flushes mirrors before checking its own fake HOME state root and removing files.
Marked non-Git and symlinked identity roots resolve to supervisor/wouldWake=true; missing roots, Git-only unmarked targets and non-file markers remain unknown/wouldWake=null.
Original request and quiet-gated prompt text and delivery results remain byte-identical; checked watcher evidence still classifies correctly.
